breakdown.description: The boundary condition of fixedValue (0 0.1 0) is set at outlet, but it should be the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly added the fixedValue boundary conditions at the inlet (matching the ground truth), but it also retained the same fixedValue conditions at the outlet (e.g., velocity of air fixedValue (0, 0.1, 0), volume fraction of air fixedValue 0.5, etc.). The ground truth only specifies these conditions at the inlet, not at the outlet. The agent duplicated rather than moved the conditions, so the original error at the outlet persists alongside the correct inlet conditions.
